$description: Foundation colour palette. TWO sources only: (1) the 12 themed custom properties declared three times each in src/styles/fourmula-base.css (:root 2094-2127, .body 2248-2265, .body.dark 2273-2286) - each property yields one token per palette, except --menu-colors which is identical in both; (2) literal hex values in SITE-AUTHORED rules only. Every histogram behind this file was scoped to site-authored rules: of the 934 rules in fourmula-base.css, 380 are Webflow framework (normalize + base reset, lines 1-2077, plus every post-2077 .w-* / w--* / wf-* / webflow-icons selector) and 554 are site-authored. #3898ec, #ddd, #ccc, #222, #333, #fafafa, #c8c8c8, #999, #5d6c7b and #e2e2e2 appear ONLY in the framework partition and are NOT design tokens - a naive whole-file histogram invents them.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.
paletteInversionWarning: LOAD-BEARING: the theme class names are INVERTED. The .body class carries the DARK values and .body.dark carries the LIGHT values, and the app ships <body class="body dark"> (index.html:16), so the DEFAULT rendered theme is LIGHT (white canvas). Do not normalise this. A generator that reads '.body.dark' as 'the dark theme' inverts the entire palette.

notTokens.reason: Webflow normalize/base-reset values (fourmula-base.css lines 1-2077 and the .w-* re-declarations at 2129-2246). Never reference them.

correctionToCloneSpec.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md:71 states "Accent used by the flash-word reveals: rgb(249, 74, 0)".
correctionToCloneSpec.finding: rgb(249,74,0) appears ZERO times anywhere in src/. The flash-word colours are set at RUNTIME by the motion scripts and there are four of them: #F94A00, #FD7B03, #FFFFFF and var(--fonts-100). They live in public/motion/m23.js, m24.js and m25.js. m22.js carries NO colour at all - it is the splitToWords() helper that creates the .flash-word spans the other three animate.

color.mainbg-dark.role: Page canvas in the DARK palette (--mainbg under .body).

color.mainbg-light.role: Page canvas in the LIGHT palette (--mainbg under .body.dark). This is the DEFAULT rendered canvas.

color.mainbg-gradient-dark.role: Transparent stop of --mainbg for gradient fades, dark palette.

color.mainbg-gradient-light.role: Transparent stop of --mainbg for gradient fades, light palette.

color.menu-light.role: Menu panel fill, light palette (near-black panel on a white page).

color.menu-colors.role: Menu accent at 20% white. IDENTICAL in both palettes - the only --* property the two palettes agree on.

color.dots-pattern-dark.role: Footer dots-field / outline-button fill, dark palette.

color.dots-pattern-light.role: Footer dots-field / outline-button fill, light palette.

color.accent-hover.role: Primary accent, used ONLY on hover: .btn-primary:hover, .ai__btn:hover, .fs-cc_link:hover. It is never a resting fill.

color.flash-orange.role: First stop of the flash-word reveal and the first stop of the is-first step gradient. Set at RUNTIME by the motion scripts, not by the stylesheet, for the reveal.

color.flash-amber.role: Second stop of the flash-word reveal; also the shared END stop of all four step gradients.

color.flash-white.role: Final stop of the m24 flash-word reveal ONLY. m23 and m25 end on var(--fonts-100) instead, so this literal is not the universal end colour.

color.grad-second-start.role: Start stop of the .is-second step gradient (blue).

color.grad-third-start.role: Start stop of the .is-third step gradient (indigo).

color.grad-third-mid.role: 23% mid stop of the .is-third step gradient (violet).

color.grad-fourth-start.role: Start stop of the .is-fourth step gradient (deep red). The fourth step gradient exists on disk and in the markup; it is NOT a three-variant set.

color.step-scrim.role: Opaque stop of the .list__main__bottom-gradient scrim (paired with its own #fc730300 transparent stop).

color.ink-black.role: Resting text colour of .ai__btn (a white pill on a dark section). Literal, not a themed property.

color.paper-white.role: Resting fill of .ai__btn and hover text of the vendored cookie buttons. Literal, not a themed property.

color.theme-toggle-hover-border.role: Border colour of .header__theme:hover (65% white). Literal; it does not follow the palette.

color.table-cell-border.role: Bottom border of .tech__rich-cell on the legal pages (15% black).

color.vendor-finsweet-accent.role: Finsweet Cookie Consent accent. NOT a Fourmula brand colour. Used on the is-cookies button hovers, .cookies__modal__close:hover and the CHECKED state of .fs-cc_checkbox-button (so it is not hover-only).

color.vendor-finsweet-accent-soft.role: Finsweet Cookie Consent hover text colour on .fs-cc_checkbox:hover. Vendored, not a brand colour.

color.vendor-finsweet-surface.role: Finsweet Cookie Consent preference-button tray fill. Vendored, not a brand colour.
